senses.gloss: Up to this or that time.
A period of 2 weeks.
A room dedicated to sadomasochistic sexual activity.
An Arctic toothed whale (Monodon monoceros) that grows to about 20 feet (6 meters) long, the male having a single horn-like tusk, a twisted, pointed cuspid that projects forward.
A sturdy bench or table at which manual work is done by a carpenter, machinist, etc.

A transcontinental country in Eastern Europe and North Asia. Official name: Russian Federation. Capital and largest city: Moscow. It borders the Pacific and Arctic Oceans and the Baltic, Black, and Caspian Seas. Part of the Soviet Union from 1917 through 1991.
(slang, now, _, chiefly, _, Irish) Alternative form of jakes: an outhouse or lavatory.
(UK, Irish, slang) Clipping of lavatory.
Unaffected by a specified operation, especially by a transformation.
(informal) Something or someone old.
A tune that keeps replaying in one's head or that one keeps thinking about, especially if unwanted.
A brief summary, as of a book or a presentation.
To cause (a piece) to become vulnerable to capture.
To get involved or involve oneself, causing disturbance.
To become involved in a situation, so as to alter or prevent an action.
Small denominations of money given in exchange for a larger denomination.
Not working; out of order.
not working properly
Which has broken down and, as a result, is no longer in working order.
Abounding in errors; not genuine or correct; in an invalid state.
That has deteriorated to the point of no longer being usable or edible.
In a state of decay.
Rendered less effective.
To disclose or reveal.
(slang) A firearm.
A personal weapon that uses explosive powder to propel a projectile often made of lead.
One who carries out a theft.
A person who steals, lies, cheats or does other dishonest or illegal things; a criminal.
one who robs
A person who breaks in to premises with the intent of committing theft.
One who disobeys or breaks rules or laws, or who acts against another's wishes.
(slang) A thief.
One who roves about for prey; one who prowls.
(UK, Irish, archaic, thieves) A petty thief or pickpocket.
The act of hunting.
The act of finding and killing a wild animal, either for sport or with the intention of using its parts to make food, clothes, etc.
(automotive, mechanical engineering) A system for activating combustion in a combustion engine.
An object of search or pursuit.
A mark left by something that has passed along.
The track or indication marking the route followed by something that has passed, such as the footprints of animal on land or the contrail of an airplane in the sky.
A mark left as a sign of passage of a person or animal.
(shoemaking) A strip of leather set into the seam between the outsole of a shoe and the upper, through which these parts are joined by stitching or stapling.
A mark left on the earth by a foot.
(figuratively) A small or trace amount.
The most extreme known value of some variable, particularly that of an achievement in competitive events.
(stock market, and, cryptocurrency, _, trading) Initialism of all-time high, referring to the value of an asset.
a person instituting criminal prosecution
One who accuses; one who brings a charge of crime or fault.
A device that projects a flame for starting fires, and sometimes also additional fuel to help ignition. Used either as a weapon or a tool.

Traditionally the third of the four seasons, when deciduous trees lose their leaves, and temperatures and daylight hours decrease; typically regarded as spanning the months of September, October, and November in the Northern Hemisphere, and the months of March, April and May in the Southern Hemisphere.
Of or relating to autumn.
An act or instance of putting clothes on.
Clothing and ornamentation; raiment.
Power or right to make or enforce rules, give orders, or impose obligation; or a position having such power or right.
A role; the position in which one functions.
(military) The obligation imposed by law or regulation on an officer or other person for keeping an accurate record of property, documents, or funds.
the quality or state of being competent for a general role
A herb of the mint family (Mentha spicata), commonly used in herb tea, candy and to treat mild stomach ache.
Bittersweet nightshade (Solanum dulcamara).
A geological event in which viscous mud flows down an incline.
Abstinence from food, limiting caloric intake, for medical or health reasons, dieting.
Fasting, abstention, abstinence; the third of the five pillars of Islam.
A series of interconnected rings or links usually made of metal.
(figurative) An element in a composite whole; a sequence of linked events or facts; a logical thread.
A line of people or things placed around an area to enclose or protect it. [from Template:SAFESUBST: c.]
(countable) A series of links united; a series or order of things depending on each other, as if linked together; a chain, a succession.
barren area
(of a place) Abandoned, without people.
A place with no remaining resources; a desert.
Deserted and devoid of inhabitants.
A place or country wasted and forsaken.
Abandoned, deserted, left behind.
One of a pair of red lights mounted on the rear of a vehicle, so it can be seen from the rear at night.
The area covered by a mobile phone (cellphone) or other radio network.
Space required by a piece of equipment.
A proposal that has been made.
Something which is proposed, or offered for consideration or acceptance.
Something suggested (with subsequent adposition being for)
The thing which has been submitted.
(uncountable) The act of offering (an idea) for consideration.
(slang) An old person.
An old person, usually a male, typically a cranky old man.
A soft, waxy, silvery reactive metal that is never found unbound in nature; an element with atomic number 19 and atomic weight of 39.0983.
In an intentional manner; on purpose.
people
The activity of going out looking at things; tourism.
Hidden, isolated, remote.

A culinary and nutritional term for several groups of non-piscine, non-tetrapod, aquatic animals that are used as a food source. The term often exclusively refers to edible aquatic crustaceans, bivalve mollusks and cephalopod mollusks; but sometimes echinoderms may be included as well.
Having bark.
The transparent layer making up the outermost front part of the eye, covering the iris, pupil, and anterior chamber.
An instantiation of a class or structure.
A material object that physically exists.
Consisting of fragments; disconnected; scattered.
Expressing anger, irritation, contempt, or disappointment.
Any of several perennial herbaceous plants, of the genus Agrimonia, that have spikes of yellow flowers.
The state when either a single computer program, or the whole system ceases to respond to inputs.
The change in state of a substance from liquid to solid by cooling to a critically low temperature.

(uncountable) The action of part or all of a national population violently rising up against the government or other authority; (countable) an instance of this; a revolt, an uprising; specifically, one that is at an initial stage or limited in nature.
Ordinary; not special.
in or at that place
A low cushioned seat with no back; a padded footstool.
Major topic of conversation; widespread rumor; information spread behind the scenes.
A statement or claim of questionable accuracy, from no known reliable source, usually spread by word of mouth.
A native of Norway.
To surmount (a physical or abstract obstacle); to prevail over, to get the better of.
(literary) To refrain from, to abstain from.
Of, pertaining to, or resembling tragicomedy; having both tragic and comic aspects.
rain
A small house or box, often raised to a considerable height above the ground, and having compartments (pigeonholes), in which domestic pigeons breed; a dove house.
Someone who has accumulated a vast amount of fame; a high-level celebrity.
A building or room where dead bodies are kept before their proper burial or cremation, (now) particularly in legal and law enforcement contexts.
The encircling wall that supports a dome or cupola.
(film) A short compilation of sample film work used as a demonstrative resume in the entertainment industry.
Any circular band or ring.

One of the simple machines; a sheave, a wheel with a grooved rim, in which a pulled rope or chain lifts an object (more useful when two or more pulleys are used together, as in a block and tackle arrangement, such that a small force moving through a greater distance can exert a larger force through a smaller distance).
A circular frame for embroidery.
A wheel having a groove in the rim for a rope to work in, and set in a block, mast, or similar; the wheel of a pulley.
a mineral consisting, like quartz, of silica, but inferior to quartz in hardness and specific gravity
A music academy.
sandy shore
A metropolitan city in Sicily, established in 2015; in full, the Metropolitan City of Palermo.
Prepared for immediate action or use.
Initialism of European Economic Area, the area consisting of the European Union plus Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein.
Worn out, wearied, exhausted or lacking enthusiasm, due to age or experience.
Lacking energy, enthusiasm, or liveliness.
An event that happens every two years.
A biennial celebration or exhibition
separation of a substance
In the manner of an uncle, pertaining to an uncle.
A bright yellow, like that of the flower petals.
The husband of one's child.
A man in the context of his own wedding; one who is going to marry or has just been married.

The assumption that all human beings are either male or female in both sex and gender, and that sexual and romantic attraction and activity only occurs, or is only normal, between people of different sexes.
The side of a right triangle opposite the right angle.
One who plagiarizes; or lifts the words, writings, or ideas of another, and passes them off as his or her own, thus engaging in plagiarism; a literary thief.
A common true thrush, Turdus merula, found in woods and gardens over much of Eurasia, and introduced elsewhere.
have snow fall from the atmosphere
A continuous part of the circumference of a circle (circular arc) or of another curve.
A person who studies, professes or practices climatology.
Of poor quality.
A chemical element (symbol La) with an atomic number of 57: a soft, ductile, silvery-white metal that tarnishes slowly when exposed to air.

A treatment, typically using ultrasound shock waves or crushing with a surgical instrument, by which a kidney stone or similar calculus is broken into particles small enough to be voided or washed out.
A town in northern Bulgaria.

A hammer that consists of a large, heavy, broad and flat block of metal (the head) attached to a handle typically 0.5 meter to 1 meter long. The sledgehammer's design is meant to allow it to be swung powerfully, and to distribute force over a wide area upon impact.
To be superior to (something); to beat, outclass.
The ruler of an absolute monarchy or the head of state of a constitutional monarchy.
A large, single block of stone which is a natural feature; or a block of stone or other similar material used in architecture and sculpture, especially one carved into a monument in ancient times.
A small cetacean of the family Phocoenidae, related to dolphins and whales.
An approval, by an authority, generally one that makes something valid.
A convex quadrilateral in which each pair of opposite edges are parallel and of equal length.
(Greek god) The goddess of divine retribution.
A mobile device intermediate in size between smartphone and tablet.
A rare, highly radioactive chemical element (symbol Po) with atomic number 84.
(countable) A nap, especially an afternoon one taken during the hottest part of the day in some cultures.
To cause (a person or animal) to be fat or fatter.
The study and calculation of quantitative (measurable) relationships of the reactants and products in chemical reactions (chemical equations).
To begin a colony or colonies.
One who writes or compiles a dictionary.
A person in whom one can confide or share one's secrets: a friend.
idol
An enclosure wherein small animals are displayed, usually with some plants, in a naturalistic setting.
In a haphazard manner; in a random, chaotic, and incomplete manner.
Soil formed of dead but not fully decayed plants found in bog areas, often burned as fuel.
Any group of three joint rulers.
A Russian carriage drawn by a team of three horses abreast.
(AI, countable, and, uncountable) Initialism of artificial intelligence.
Sometimes followed by up: to force (something) out of the lungs or throat by pushing air from the lungs through the glottis (causing a short, explosive sound), and out through the mouth.
In a sad manner; sorrowfully.
